description: Open an interactive composer to draft or schedule a social media post. Shows the user's connected channels to pick from and pre-fills any provided text. The user finishes in the UI; on submit it creates the post via create_post. Use this when the user wants to compose a post interactively in a UI — prefer this over create_post when they'd review before posting.

content.description: Optional initial text to pre-fill the composer with.

name: compose_post
title: Compose a post
